## Personality

Lesseps is characterized by an extraordinary determination, possessing what is described as a genius of will. Through this sheer force of personality, he is able to achieve triumph.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P58](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0058)_

## History

Lesseps undertook the ambitious endeavor of joining two seas to shorten the sea route from [Cadiz](../codex/places.md#cadiz) to [India](../codex/places.md#india) by piercing the isthmus. His work initially met with disgust and rebuffs, but through the genius of his will, he ultimately triumphed and succeeded in creating the junction. His successful creation raised the possibility that future geographical phenomena could complicate his accomplished work.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P57](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0057), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P58](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0058), [v2 CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS P14](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0014)_
